warmup: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/app/vendor/bundle -v $PWD:/app -w /app ruby:3.4 bundle install
install: docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/app/vendor/bundle -v $PWD:/app -w /app ruby:3.4 bundle install

db.cmd: docker start -a hm-postgres || docker run --name hm-postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=app -p 54329:5432 postgres:17-alpine

redis.cmd: docker start -a hm-redis || docker run --name hm-redis -p 63799:6379 redis:8-alpine

sidekiq.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 54329 -q; do sleep 1; done' && docker rm -f hm-sidekiq >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name hm-sidekiq --network host --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/app/vendor/bundle -v $PWD:/app -w /app ruby:3.4 bundle exec sidekiq

web.cmd: timeout 180 sh -c 'until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 54329 -q; do sleep 1; done' && docker rm -f hm-rails >/dev/null 2>&1; exec docker run --rm --name hm-rails --network host --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -e BUNDLE_PATH=/app/vendor/bundle -e PORT=${PORT:-3000} -v $PWD:/app -w /app ruby:3.4 bash -c 'bin/rails db:prepare && exec bin/rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p $PORT'
